metadata.case_name: HUSSAIN SHOUKAT v. MA CHI TAT AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: General labourer (casual work at construction sites and loading and unloading)

injuries.description: Multiple facial and skull vault fractures
source: Multiple facial and skull vault fractures
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures involving skull or facial bones

source: The injury leads to a post-concussion syndrome suffered by the Plaintiff which caused headaches and dizziness.
Dr. Choa assessed the Plaintiff as suffering 5% impairment of whole person for his post concussion syndrome and psychological changes.

injuries.description: Intertrochanteric fracture of the left femur
source: Intertrochanteric fracture of the left femur

injuries.description: Comminuted fracture of the left distal radius and fracture of the ulna
source: Comminuted fracture of the left distal radius and fracture of the ulna
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

injuries.description: Fracture of the distal radius of the right wrist
source: Fracture of the distal radius of the right wrist
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at wrist or hand level

source: He is also suffered from post-traumatic adjustment disorder.

manifestations.description: Loss of consciousness for about 9 hours
Post traumatic amnesia for about 9 hours
Slight limitation of left hip movement
Diffuse tenderness of the left hip and left lower limb
Unilateral muscle wasting of left thigh suggesting some degree of persistent pain and disuse of the left lower limb
Limitation of movements of the left wrist and muscle slightly weak and slight unilateral muscle atrophy of left forearm and arm
Weak grip and reduced muscle power of the left wrist
X-rays of the left wrist showed some irregularity at the joint surface suggesting some articular surface damage and a high chance of post traumatic arthritis
Impaired ability to exert heavily with his hand as well as prolonged walking when carrying weight
Unable to return to work as a construction site worker

treatments_received.treatment: Open reduction and internal fixation of the left forearm
source: On 24 July 2006 the Plaintiff was underwent an operation of open reduction and internal fixation of the left forearm and close reduction and internal fixation of the left hip.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for arm / leg / patella / scapula +/- internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: Close reduction and internal fixation of the left hip
source: On 24 July 2006 the Plaintiff was underwent an operation of open reduction and internal fixation of the left forearm and close reduction and internal fixation of the left hip.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Closed reduction for fracture of femur +/- internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: Immobilisation of the right wrist by Plaster-of-Paris
source: His right wrist was immobilized by Plaster-of-Paris.

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy for 4-5 months at Yan Chai Hospital
source: He underwent physiotherapy for 4 	6 5 months at Yan Chai Hospital

treatments_received.treatment: Occupational therapy for 3-4 months at Princess Margaret Hospital
source: and also a course of occupational therapy for 3 	6 4 months at Princess Margaret Hospital.

losses.description: Unable to return to work as a construction site worker and will suffer disadvantage in the employment market by reason of continuing disabilities.

Impaired ability to exert heavily with his hand; limitation of movements, muscle weakness and atrophy of left forearm/arm; weak grip; articular surface damage of left wrist with high chance of post-traumatic arthritis; diffuse tenderness and muscle wasting of left lower limb.
Post-concussion syndrome causing headaches and dizziness and post-traumatic adjustment disorder.
